name: Atom Robotics
name_zh: 天津辰星技术股份有限公司
summary:
Tianjin Chenxing Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013. It is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise, a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise, and a leading domestic brand in high-speed industrial robotics. Guided by its mission of 'creating a better life through technology,' the company focuses on innovation and large-scale applications of high-speed, high-precision and highly reliable parallel robots, high-speed SCARA robots, heavy-payload collaborative robots, embodied intelligent robots, and core components such as controllers, integrated drive-and-control systems and vision systems. It has developed an independently built, full-stack AI and robotics technology platform.

In its core parallel-robot market, Atom Robotics ranked first in market share among domestic Chinese brands for five consecutive years starting in 2020. From 2023, it surpassed foreign brands to rank first across all brands in China for two consecutive years. Its products are widely used in food and beverages, daily-use chemicals, pharmaceuticals, new energy, computing/communications/consumer electronics (3C), automotive and other industries. It has provided high-performance robots and intelligent solutions to more than 1000 substantial enterprises worldwide, using technology to improve productivity and bring innovation into practical industrial use and everyday life. Its business spans more than 30 countries and regions.
